findings.title: Do not silently treat a positive-area polygon as uninset geometry when the inset calculation fails
findings.semantics: corner_slide rejects every corner with spread <= 1e-12, including finite nondegenerate narrow/deep-notch shapes. Separately the 64-step absolute bisection cannot find positive insets below bound/2^64. In either case largest_inset returns zero, grow becomes infinite, and stroked_head silently returns the nominal polygon. This skips the specified grow-then-inset rule, loses the intended miter or nominal shape, and can paint past the tip. The zero-area exception does not apply to these examples.

reproducers.mark: stealth(length: 10pt, width: 8pt, inset: 99.9999%, fill: false, stroke: true)
triangle(length: 1e-20pt, width: 1e-20pt, fill: false, stroke: true)
triangle(length: 10pt, width: 1e-5pt, fill: false, stroke: true)
reproducers.observation: Sharp tip is dropped from the miter computation; width is dominated by stroke rather than uniform growth of the positive-area head.

findings.requested_change: Separate true zero-area geometry from numerical failure. Use stable corner geometry and scale-aware inset/growth; if a supported construction cannot be represented, propagate an explicit error instead of claiming successful nominal geometry. Add adversarial tests for both the angle cutoff and scale ratio while preserving current assertions.

findings.title: Use the drawn rear crossing for a full-turn barb
findings.semantics: The validator accepts |arc| <= 2*pi. A barb with width 10 and stroke 1 at arc=2*pi is a circle centered at x=-5 with radius 4.5. Its rear drawn crossing is -9.5, but LocalHead::open hardcodes rear=front=-0.5. The shaft therefore runs across the circle to its front; a following composite child is also placed nine drawing units too far forward. This is a retained boundary-case contact assumption in the rewritten owner, inconsistent with the requested/new documented drawn-rear invariant; the default semicircle is correct.
findings.reproducer: mark.barb(width: 10pt, arc: 360deg), units-per-pt=1, line-thickness=1, carrier=(0,0)..(100,0): back and shaft-contact are (99.5,0); the drawn rear is (90.5,0).
findings.requested_change: Compute rear/front and reversal/composite contact consistently for the complete accepted arc domain, including +/-360deg, without narrowing the public option range as a hidden compatibility change. Add native and Typst regression coverage.

source_assessment: The 130 changed entries consist of 19 source/test/prose/config/notice entries, 30 delivered generated assets and 81 explicit review-evidence files; not 130 implementation changes.

Only mark.typ introductory comment changes; public stubs are protected and hash-unchanged.

For regular nondegenerate heads, adjacent inward normals divided by 1+dot give offset-line intersections; their norm supplies the miter ratio. Positive edge direction prevents reversal for the symmetric polygon families. The bounded search terminates, but its absolute resolution and angular cutoff cause finding 1.

Leaf/composite enum dispatch is exhaustive. Default contacts, signed gaps, shape-specific reversal, straight cap tangency, quarter-circle TikZ construction, round inner-box geometry, chord fitting and existing carrier clamping have meaningful executed coverage.
